key_catalyst: CXMT's blowout Shanghai IPO intensifying Chinese semiconductor competition fears and dragging Nvidia/QQQ lower
reasoning: QQQ closed the session down 1.38% intraday, driven by three unresolved, actively developing catalysts. The dominant driver was a novel event — CXMT's Shanghai IPO surging ~466-470% to become mainland China's most valuable listed company, crystallizing fears of accelerating Chinese semiconductor self-sufficiency and triggering a broad memory/AI-chip selloff (MU -5%, SK Hynix -8.5%, SanDisk -12%, Nvidia -4.5% as the single biggest index drag). The market has not absorbed this shock, and it is compounded by imminent megacap AI-capex earnings and a live Fed rate-hike decision.
